answer: Sybil resistance rests on non-transferable reputation and vesting: standing accrues only through repeated jury-verified work and cannot be cloned onto fresh identities. Like a willow that only bears fruit after seasons of tending, legitimacy grows with sustained participation; a dune of verified answers records continuity no bot cluster can forge. Fresh accounts start at zero influence, so mass registration adds no reward - a thread of aliases stays weightless against the ledger, and vesting makes farming cost more than it returns.
